+# Mini Template
+
+A dependency-free TypeScript template renderer for Bun.
+
+```ts
+import { render } from "./src/engine";
+
+render("Hello, {{user.name}}!", { user: { name: "Ada" } });
+```
+
+Supported syntax:
+
+- `{{path}}` HTML-escapes scalar values; `{{{path}}}` writes raw values.
+- `{{#if path}}...{{else}}...{{/if}}` supports nested conditionals.
+- `{{#each path}}...{{else}}...{{/each}}` iterates arrays with `{{this}}` and `{{@index}}`.
+- `{{! comment }}` is removed. Missing interpolation values render as empty strings.
+
+Run a template from files:
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts TEMPLATE_FILE DATA.json
+```
+
+Run the self-tests:
+
+```sh
+bun test
+```
